name: const unsafe fn as_uninit_slice < 'a > (self) -> Option < & 'a [MaybeUninit < T >] >
rule: If self is non-null, the entire slice memory range must be contained within a single allocated object and must not span multiple allocated objects, even if the result of as_uninit_slice is unused.
